create_dot_product_attention: create dot-product attention with query, key, value tensors, optional bias, dropout, and rotary embeddings
build_multihead_attention: build multi-head dot-product attention module with configurable heads, head_dim, dropout, and autoregressive cache support
create_rotary_embedding: create rotary positional embeddings by generating sin/cos tensors from features and sequence length
build_decoder_mask: build combined decoder attention mask from causal, padding, and segment masks for prefix-lm and packed sequences
create_t5_layer_norm: create T5-style layer normalization that operates on the last axis without subtracting mean or bias
